items.title: Joe Robichaux Interview, 1959-03-19
items.q: So I told Lawrence, Christmas evening, the night I was leaving, he brought me here. He brought me home because I had to get ready to go to the station.

ctx.x: Well that's right, I haven't seen him since I've been there.
Rudolph, I think. Yeah, well he drives a cab on the Morrison cab line. Then he's got a nephew there which is... Oh Lawrence Dent, I know him.
Lawrence Dent, yeah. I know him, I see him, he plays in one of the bands, the Gibson band. Is that good clarinet now?
